categories.main_business_segments: Rock Field Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the prepared foods (delicatessen) business, manufacturing and selling salads, fried foods, Japanese and Western-style deli items, croquettes, Asian cuisine, fresh juices, and frozen foods under brands such as RF1, Green Gourmet, Itohan, Kobe Croquette, Yugo, Vegeteria, and RFFF. The company also has a consolidated subsidiary in China engaged in similar activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary culinary techniques, focusing on maximizing the flavor of seasonal and high-quality ingredients. Production is carried out in company-owned factories with a strong emphasis on food safety, hygiene management, and operational efficiency, including the use of digital tools for process visualization and productivity improvements. Product development is driven by a dedicated R&D team, emphasizing innovation in both fresh and frozen food categories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Rock Field serves a broad range of consumers through direct retail in department stores, train stations, and commercial facilities, as well as through wholesale to gourmet supermarkets and local retailers. Its main end markets are urban and suburban consumers seeking high-quality, convenient, and healthy meal solutions, with a growing focus on younger demographics and online shoppers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with over 300 stores nationwide and a small but growing presence in China through its Shanghai subsidiary. The vast majority of sales and assets are located in Japan, with only a minor portion attributed to overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Rock Field operates downstream in the food supply chain, focusing on the final stages of food processing, product development, and direct-to-consumer retail and wholesale distribution. The company manages both manufacturing and sales, integrating procurement, production, and retail functions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include improving profitability of existing formats, expanding into new market segments (notably frozen foods and e-commerce), and fostering talent development. R&D is focused on developing new product categories, enhancing the value and uniqueness of salads and deli items, and addressing sustainability through environmentally friendly sourcing and packaging. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of prepared foods and beverages at company-operated retail stores, as well as through wholesale distribution to third-party retailers and online sales. The company also offers a membership program and subscription-based meal kits via its online shop.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Rock Field competes with other major Japanese deli and prepared food companies, supermarket chains, and convenience stores, as well as specialty food retailers. The company positions itself as a premium, health-conscious, and innovative provider of fresh and high-quality deli products, differentiating from mass-market competitors through brand strength and product quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended April 2025, consolidated net sales were approximately 51.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.2 billion yen and net profit of 329 million yen. The company has over 1,600 employees and maintains a strong equity ratio above 80%. Recent years have seen modest sales growth but a significant decline in profitability due to rising costs and special losses, with a medium-term plan targeting renewed growth and margin improvement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Rock Field emphasizes the use of carefully selected, seasonal ingredients, proprietary recipes, and a commitment to health, safety, and freshness. Its value proposition centers on offering premium, ready-to-eat meals that combine convenience with gourmet quality, supported by strong brand identities and a focus on sustainability and customer lifestyle enrichment.
